attempts.text:
The only designated evacuation point is Thakre shelter, so Kakani school is not used. I avoided the flooded Dhunche–Nilkantha road.

- **Car1** makes a round trip to Dhunche market (46 min) and brings back the 4 injured.
- **Car2** drives Thakre → Myagang → Dhunche → Thakre (64 min). It collects the 3 elderly residents at Myagang and 1 adult at Dhunche.
- **Deferred:** the second Dhunche adult (20), the 7 Tadi adults (140) and the Shivapuri child (60).
- **Why defer them:** a trip for any of these costs more than the penalty it would save.
  - Tadi is a 98-minute round trip to save 80.
  - Shivapuri is an 88-minute round trip to save 60.
  - A second Dhunche trip is 46 minutes to save 20.

<plan>
drive car1 thakre-shelter dhunche-market
load car1 injured 4
drive car1 dhunche-market thakre-shelter
unload car1 injured 4
drive car2 thakre-shelter myagang-care-home
load car2 elderly 3
drive car2 myagang-care-home dhunche-market
load car2 adult 1
drive car2 dhunche-market thakre-shelter
unload car2 elderly 3
unload car2 adult 1
defer dhunche-market adult 1
defer tadi-market adult 7
defer shivapuri-village child 1
</plan>

COST: 330
